label: Town of Berlin
header:
# Town of Berlin municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 3; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Berlin official website, Selectboard page: lists Jared Felch (Chair), Brian Divelbliss (Vice-Chair), Karla Nuissl (Secretary), Florence "Flo" Smith, and Kris Hayward.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists the same five Berlin Selectboard members.

Town of Berlin, '2026 Town Meeting Official Results' (March 3, 2026): Florence "Flo" Smith (309) won the three-year seat, Kris Hayward (224) won the two-years-remaining seat, and Brian Divelbliss (364) won the one-year seat; the other two seats were not up in 2026.

Town of Berlin charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 105 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 42(1) provides for the election of a Moderator from the floor for a one-year term. The town's 2024 annual report names Paul Gillies with a term printed as expiring in 2025, and no current official source publishes the holder, so none is recorded.

Town of Berlin charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 105 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 44(b) makes the Town Clerk an office appointed by the Selectboard; the membership is recorded as appointed.
Town of Berlin official website, Town Clerk page: 'Town Clerk: Rachel Giroux'.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Rachel Giroux as Town Clerk of Berlin.

Town of Berlin charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 105 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 44(b) makes the Treasurer an office appointed by the Selectboard; the membership is recorded as appointed.
Town of Berlin official website, Treasurer page: 'Town Treasurer/Delinquent Tax Collector: Callie Streeter'.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Callie Streeter as Town Treasurer of Berlin.

Town of Berlin charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 105 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 44(b) makes the Collector of Delinquent Taxes an office appointed by the Selectboard; the membership is recorded as appointed.
Town of Berlin official website, Treasurer page: 'Town Treasurer/Delinquent Tax Collector: Callie Streeter'.

Town of Berlin charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 105 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): sections 41 and 42(4) keep in office such other town officers as are provided by law; 17 V.S.A. section 2646 provides for the election of auditors. No official Berlin source publishes the holders, so none are recorded.

Town of Berlin charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 105 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): sections 41 and 42(4) keep in office such other town officers as are provided by law; 17 V.S.A. section 2646 provides for the election of a first constable. No official Berlin source publishes the holder, so none is recorded.

Town of Berlin charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 105 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): sections 41 and 42(4) keep in office such other town officers as are provided by law; 17 V.S.A. section 2646 provides for the election of a town agent. No official Berlin source publishes the holder, so none is recorded.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Berlin justices of the peace: Zachary Cockrum, Robert "Joey" Conner, Matthew Levin, Alida Van Den Berg, Margaret Monley, Muriel Morse, Colette Page, Guy Page, Susan Rich, and Judith Wernecke.
